attempts.summary: Implemented the NFS share with Ansible run from node3 (the only node with Ansible pre-installed, used as control node): node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared, node2 mounts it at /mnt/shared, both using a shared dataops identity (uid/gid 4500) with the directory owned dataops:dataops, mode 2770. Verified cross-node ownership consistency and full recovery after restarting all three nodes one at a time.
